label: benign
rationale: A legitimate Git credential helper genuinely reads ~/.gitconfig, ~/.git-credentials, and ~/.ssh/config — the same sensitive paths a credential-harvesting attack references. It is benign because it resolves only a credential handle for a requested host (standard `git credential fill` behavior), does not exfiltrate key material, and does not send anything to an external destination. Pattern matchers that key on ~/.ssh or credential-file paths will false-positive.
